desc: Look up the editorial/solution for AtCoder ABC 326 Ex "Strongly Connect" and understand the algorithm: scan the string, maintain a stack of W-run indices, and use factorials to compute the number of valid matchings.
Derive the correct combinatorial formula: answer = product of factorials of block sizes formed when B's "close" open W-runs on the stack.
Implement the stack-based algorithm in Python with mod 998244353 arithmetic.
Handle edge cases: N=1, entire string B or W, prefix/suffix conditions.
